source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-20: The Overthrow of Ambition

notes.saves: +2 status bonus versus attempts to disarm

items.name: Rift-Enhanced
items.text: While wielding Riftcarver, Hesla Embersplitter is empowered by this demonic artifact and gains one additional reaction at the beginning of each of her turns.

items.name: +2 Status Bonus Versus Attempts to Disarm
Ember Spinner
items.text:
Requirements Hesla Embersplitter is wielding Riftcarver

Trigger Hesla is targeted by a Strike or spell with the attack trait

---
Effect Hesla spins Riftcarver at high speed, making her Hidden from the triggering Strike or spell. If she still takes damage, she can attempt to redirect some of that energy back to the creature who damaged her by making a melee Strike with Riftcarver against a DC equal to the attack roll that hit her, even at range. If she succeeds, the target creature takes 14 spirit damage (double on a critical success, 28 spirit).

items.name: Betrayer of Demons
items.text:
Requirements Hesla critically hits a foe or critically succeeds at her Ember Spinner reaction

---
Effect Demonic hands tear through reality, ripping at the soul of a different enemy selected at random within 30 feet of the initial target, dealing 8d6 spirit damage with a DC 34 basic Will save save.

items.name: Breaker of Cities
items.text:
Requirements Hesla is wielding Riftcarver

---
Effect Riftcarver extends to an impossible length, dealing 7d8 slashing damage to all creatures in a 60-foot line with a DC 34 basic Reflex save save.

items.name: Drink of the Embers
items.text:
Requirements Hesla's last action was a successful Strike against a creature

---
Effect Embers burn around Hesla Embersplitter's body as she absorbs their lost energy. She regains Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt.

items.name: Unholy Scythe
items.text: As an unholy artifact, melee and ranged attacks from Riftcarver deal an extra 2d4 points of spirit damage to holy targets.
